name: io.github.granitebps/youtube-mcp
title: YouTube MCP
description: Read YouTube video metadata, transcripts, comments, and search results. No API key needed.

environmentVariables.name: YT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider for video info, comments, and search: "innertube" (default, no key) or "api" (YouTube Data API v3). Transcripts always use youtube-transcript-plus.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: YouTube Data API v3 key. Required when YT_PROVIDER is "api".
